dispositions.reason: A v1 value is the text the import file gives for a v1 customer reference, an identity of v1 that the mapping carries until the Customer is made; rule 7 compares identities by Unicode code point of their text, so the Customers the mapping makes are ordered by the code points of that text. No other order is open.
